# Ray Data execution context

This page maps 92 Ray Data names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite Ray Data code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from ray_data --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.

The following table maps the 86 names on `DataContext` fields, sorted alphabetically.

## `ExecutionOptions`

The following table maps the 6 names on `ExecutionOptions`, sorted alphabetically.

| Ray Data | Batcher | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_locality_enabled` | n/a | out of scope | Declined: deprecated by Ray (actor locality is managed internally); Batcher has DistributedConfig.locality\_aware\_scheduling. |
